image_description: A close-up view of a bicycle wheel hub featuring a mechanical disc brake system. Visible elements include the black bicycle fork, thin metal spokes radiating from the central hub, a silver metallic brake rotor (disc) with ventilation holes, and a dark grey caliper assembly mounted to the frame. The background is a blurred natural setting.
